reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Ordinary muscle soreness from a hard session is no reason to skip. Easy movement, a walk or a light session, usually helps it ease off. If you're training, keep it lighter on whatever's sore and stay a couple of reps shy of failure. If you're properly wrecked, a rest day is a fine call too. Want me to build you a light session for today?"}
